name: smart-finance
description: Smart Finance — Personal Finance Manager (root workspace scripts)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
